package.description: Offline Markdown viewer and editor for Windows

en-US.description: Offline Markdown viewer and editor for Windows
en-US.longDescription: MDViewer+ is an offline Markdown viewer and editor with live preview. The Full edition is the recommended installer.
en-US.name: MDViewer+ for Windows
en-US.releaseNotes:
Full is the recommended edition. Lite is the minimum-footprint edition. Windows installers are currently unsigned; verify the attached SHA-256 files before installation.
Thanks to sdkks/mdviewer (https://github.com/sdkks/mdviewer) and jnscnn/mdviewer-plus-plus (https://github.com/jnscnn/mdviewer-plus-plus) for the implementation input behind several Lite/Full features in this release. See CHANGELOG.md for details.
